layout.hcal_v1/admitted/: verified copies of the lra units, teachers, deploy input, frozen bank tables and ADMISSION_RECEIPT.json (never written after admission)
layout.hcal_v1/run/units/<unit>/: atomic study units: files + record.json + COMPLETE.json
layout.dependencies/jcv_v1/inputs/adult_jcv.npz: the pinned source input, bundled so the copy restores alone

restore: copy hcal_v1 back to <PRIVATE_CACHE>/hcal_v1 only if the live store is lost
re-run the restore hooks of hcal.closeout on the copy root
off_device_copy: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=. <python> -m hcal.sema --label F:closeout -- env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=. <python> -m hcal.closeout offdevice   (finds <DRIVE_ROOT> by content; copies <PRIVATE_CACHE>/hcal_v1 and the pinned input to <DRIVE_ROOT>/private_hcal_v1_<UTC date>[_vN], re-reads every file uncached, then the coordinator runs the restore hooks on that copy)
layout_note: outer__ assessment units, if present, are copied byte for byte and never parsed by custody
